entities.name: Online Bookstore
entities.description: A cloud-native e-commerce platform providing catalogue browsing, secure checkout, customer reviews, and personalized recommendations for physical and electronic books.

entities.name: Book Buyer / Customer and Site Visitor
entities.description: People interacting with the platform via HTTPS to browse catalogues, make purchases, write reviews, and receive recommendations.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External payment processing service such as Stripe or PayPal.

entities.name: Third-Party Shipping Providers
entities.description: External shipping services such as FedEx and UPS APIs for fulfillment.

entities.name: Tax & Compliance Service
entities.description: External tax and compliance service such as Avalara.

entities.name: Recommendation Engine
entities.description: AWS Personalize service providing personalized book recommendations.

entities.name: Email/Notification Service
entities.description: Amazon SES for sending emails and notifications.

entities.name: Centralized Logging & SIEM
entities.description: Centralized logging and security information and event management system.

entities.name: Public Catalog & Search SPA & Authenticated Customer Portal SPA
entities.description: Single page applications providing public catalogue browsing, search, and the authenticated customer portal.
entities.technology: Amazon S3, Amazon CloudFront, AWS WAF

entities.name: AWS API Gateway
entities.description: Manages and routes incoming API requests to internal microservices with mutual TLS.
entities.technology: AWS API Gateway, AWS App Mesh

entities.name: Catalog & Search Service
entities.description: Handles book catalog browsing and search functionalities.
entities.technology: Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, AWS ECS on Fargate

entities.name: Order & Checkout Service
entities.description: Manages secure checkout and order processing workflows.
entities.technology: Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, AWS ECS on Fargate

entities.name: Recommendation & Review Service
entities.description: Provides book recommendations and customer reviews.
entities.technology: Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, AWS ECS on Fargate

entities.name: Customer Review & Moderation Service
entities.description: Moderates and manages customer submitted reviews.
entities.technology: Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, AWS ECS on Fargate

entities.name: Notification & Engagement Worker
entities.description: Processes asynchronous notification tasks and engagement messages.
entities.technology: Node.js/Express, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, AWS ECS on Fargate

entities.name: Amazon RDS
entities.description: Relational database storage for persistent application data.

entities.name: Redis on Amazon ElastiCache
entities.description: In-memory caching layer for performance optimization and protecting checkout availability.

entities.name: Amazon SQS
entities.description: Message queue for decoupled asynchronous messaging between services.

entities.name: AWS Secrets Manager
entities.description: Manages secrets, encryption keys, and sensitive configuration data.
